data.text: Luke, taking the whole lake means one payday and no fish—or fishing income—afterward. Joining you in a race to empty it won’t protect our livelihoods. My family taught me to leave enough for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons today, we can each catch 10 tons, leave 50, and have the lake back at 100 next month. That’s $10,000 each month apiece if we keep the agreement. I’m willing to take that share, but we need all five committed before fishing. Luke, will you withdraw your 100-ton demand and join an equal 10-ton limit?
